title: LLM / Ollama configuration
description: Configuration for text generation and summarization
apiEndpointHint: Ollama, vLLM, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
correctionModelHint: Small, fast model for live-view correction when using Whisper for near-live, e.g. qwen2.5:0.5b
enableThinkingHint: Disabled by default: reasoning models (e.g. MedGemma, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1) can otherwise take extremely long or hang on summaries.

sanitizer.title: PII sanitizer
sanitizer.description: Anonymizes sensitive data in the transcript before it is sent to the LLM
